evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus and anterior horn of lateral meniscus with extending into the surface, R/O tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus and anterior horn of lateral meniscus with extending into the surface, R/O tear.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Bone contusion in medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau.
evidence.Fracture: Fracture of posterior tibial intercondylar eminence with avulsion fracture of PCL.
